prompts.ask: Answer the question below directly. Give the conclusion first, then the necessary explanation; if there is not enough information, say so explicitly.
prompts.explain: Explain the content below clearly. Use plain language to cover the core concepts, the key relationships, and one short example; avoid unrelated digressions.
prompts.translate: Detect the language of the text and translate it into English; if it is already in English, translate it into natural Chinese. Preserve terminology, formulas, and paragraph structure, and output only the translation.
prompts.summarize: Summarize the content below. Output: a one-sentence thesis, 3-5 key points, and the keywords worth remembering.
prompts.hint: Treat the content below as a study exercise. Do not give the final answer; first identify what it tests, then give layered hints and the next step to take.
